newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Friday after gaining during the day on expectations that Japan's rubber stocks will start falling, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 1.3 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark April was up 0.1 yen at 141.5 yen.
During the day, prices edged up from the afternoon session as outlook for an improvement in Japan's rubber stocks fuelled short-covering, the traders said.
